description:
WA FWS LPO MULTI(1) Little Pend Oreille NWR Culvert Improvements

Little Pend Oreille National Wildlife Refuge

Pend Oreille, Washington

This Work consists of replacement of 6 Aquatic Organism Passage (AOP) culverts within the Wildlife refuge,. See “Project Description” posted under Attachments for additional details.

Project Location: approximately 75 Miles North of Spokane, Washington (city).

Project Length: 0.23 Miles

Estimated Price Range: between $2,000,000 and $5,000,000

Tentative Solicitation Date: Spring/ Summer 2026

Contract Type: Sealed Bid; Firm-Fixed-Price

Tentative Fixed Completion Date: this project has multiple schedules

Schedule A, fixed completion date: Fall 2027

Schedule B, fixed completion date: Fall 2028

Schedule C, fixed completion date: Fall 2028

INTERESTED VENDORS LIST: To view the Interested Vendors List, you must register as a SAM user, be logged in, and linked to an entity. If you are signed into SAM.gov with your registered entity and you cannot see the Interested Vendors List, you will need to be assigned the Contract Opportunities Administrator role for your entity in SAM.gov. If you need assistance, call the Federal Service Desk at 866-606-8220.

To ensure you receive notification when the solicitation documents are posted to SAM.gov, please click on the “follow” button at the top of the opportunity page.  When solicitation documents are issued, the INVITATION FOR BIDS/REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL (specifications and plans) will be posted at this link.
